page.overview:
Who is Balgus?

Balgus is an older, grizzled dwarf with long gray hair that is pulled into straight braids in the back. He has a big bushy beard. His grin looked like a "railroad of terror."

Balgus has a hunched posture, but when he flexes his rippling muscles become apparent.

Balgus is a frequent drinker; he owns his own brewery and is a regular at the Iron Hearth Tavern. Incredibly tough, Balgus laughed off a strong hit that he didn't see coming from Vax'ildan.

Vox Machina first encountered Balgus while he was passed out drunk at the Iron Hearth Tavern in Kraghammer. Grog and Scanlan went up to Balgus, where the goliath tried to get his attention by showing off the scar on his chest. Scanlan played some music on his flute to cast a Healing Word spell on Balgus to wake him up. The dwarf awoke, wondering where the music was coming from and pawing towards the flute.
